reason: 该插件是一个主题选择与管理插件：它在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中提供主题管理页面，支持应用主题与已安装主题插件的展示与切换，并通过市场接口维护单主题独占与状态同步；因此其主要用户面对用途为界面主题与布局管理。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板中提供主题管理入口，可查看并切换应用主题与已安装主题插件，并在同一时间仅保留一个主题生效。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Themes page in DeepSeek Harness settings to manage and switch app themes and installed theme plugins, while ensuring only one theme is active at a time.

capabilities: Theme switching for built-in app themes
Theme plugin listing and activation management
State persistence through market state storage

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a Settings "Themes" page to manage app themes and installed theme plugins with one active at a time
README lists dsh-market endpoints used for installed/registry queries and skin enablement including POST /dsh-market/use-skin and POST /dsh-market/toggle
README explains theme/plugin selection is persisted to state.json and synchronized every 6 seconds with market page status

capabilities: Theme switching for built-in app themes
Theme plugin listing and activation management
State persistence through market state storage
